title: 新加坡東北地鐵線~Singapore North East Line
focus: 地下自動化捷運牽引通訊與疏散~Underground automated metro traction communication and egress
summary: 以新加坡東北地鐵線為背景，建立全地下自動運轉的教學案例。課程把供電、定位、車門與通風連成系統事件鏈，並以通訊失效和列車停在站間的情境檢查旅客資訊、備援能源及復原次序。~Use Singapore’s North East Line as the setting for an underground automated-operation teaching case. Connect power, localisation, doors and ventilation through system events. Use lost communication and an interstation stop to test passenger information, backup energy and recovery sequence, while distinguishing a reliable data link from the proof that a movement is safely authorised.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 stale_distance=7.65 m；單元 2 得 sigma=1.795841 m；單元 3 得 combinations=256 states。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 latency 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.415 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以新加坡東北地鐵線為背景，建立全地下自動運轉的教學案例。課程把供電、定位、車門與通風連成系統事件鏈，並以通訊失效和列車停在站間的情境檢查旅客資訊、備援能源及復原次序。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives stale_distance=7.65 m; unit 2 gives sigma=1.795841 m; unit 3 gives combinations=256 states. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing latency in the first unit changes its result to 8.415 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Singapore’s North East Line as the setting for an underground automated-operation teaching case. Connect power, localisation, doors and ventilation through system events. Use lost communication and an interstation stop to test passenger information, backup energy and recovery sequence, while distinguishing a reliable data link from the proof that a movement is safely authorised. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2003 年：新加坡東北地鐵線開始營運服務；2024 年：東北線榜鵝海岸站於十二月開放營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以新加坡東北地鐵線為背景，建立全地下自動運轉的教學案例。課程把供電、定位、車門與通風連成系統事件鏈，並以通訊失效和列車停在站間的情境檢查旅客資訊、備援能源及復原次序。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2003: Singapore’s North East Line entered passenger service; 2024: Punggol Coast station on the North East Line opened in December. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Singapore’s North East Line as the setting for an underground automated-operation teaching case. Connect power, localisation, doors and ventilation through system events. Use lost communication and an interstation stop to test passenger information, backup energy and recovery sequence, while distinguishing a reliable data link from the proof that a movement is safely authorised. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.mechanism: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 以封包遺失和延遲分別測試自動運轉的授權有效期。~A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Test automatic-operation authority validity separately under lost packets and delayed packets.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.306 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.65 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3366 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.415 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.306 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.65 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3366 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.415 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.
units.verify: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。~Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.
units.failure: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。~Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.
units.misconception: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達~A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
units.practice: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.title: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 把輪徑誤差對地下定位的累積與參考點校正分開。~Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Separate accumulated underground odometry error from correction at reference points.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.488 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.826817 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.488 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.826817 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。~Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.
units.failure: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。~A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.
units.misconception: 兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差~Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
units.practice: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 對站間列車和後續列車建立進路不可同時允許的條件。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Define conditions that prohibit conflicting authority for an interstation train and a following train.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=8 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=256 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 9 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 512 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=8 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=256 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 9 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 512 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.mechanism: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。 停車、測量與門位置三個獨立零均值誤差以變異數相加，再取平方根得到合成標準差。這不是最大偏移保證，也不含共同系統偏差；機械淨空及容許對位範圍須另外核對。 把列車停準與站門位置誤差分開，檢查共同偏差會否低估對位。~Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately. Geometric alignment does not replace obstruction detection or the door-closure interlock. Three independent zero-mean errors in stopping, surveying and door position combine through summed variances. The square root gives a standard deviation, not a guaranteed maximum offset. Shared bias is excluded, and mechanical clearance and permitted alignment ranges require separate checks. Separate stopping and platform-door position errors and check whether shared bias understates alignment error.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.08976 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09317649 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m. Sensitivity: stop_sigma, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.08976 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.09317649 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean errors; not a maximum bound and no acceptance tolerance is specified.
units.verify: 以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。 以獨立基準重複量測停準與門位，檢查各誤差平均值、相關性和單位，再核對合成分布。~Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Repeat stopping and door-position measurements against an independent reference, check each mean, correlation and unit, and compare the combined distribution.
units.failure: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。~Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A shared positioning bias makes the root-sum-square model understate actual alignment offset.
units.misconception: 停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移~A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
units.practice: 把隨機誤差和固定偏移分開做誤差預算，畫出不同載重的停準分布，列出對位與互鎖需分別驗證的證據。 再以本單元 stop_sigma 的對照值重算 combined_sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build separate random-error and fixed-bias budgets, plot stopping distributions at different loads, and list distinct evidence for alignment and interlocking. Also recalculate combined_sigma for the alternative stop_sigma value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.mechanism: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 把一般換氣與停車時旅客負荷分開建立空氣量估算。~A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Estimate normal ventilation separately from passenger load during a stopped-train scenario.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 28.05 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 246.2658 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.05 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 246.2658 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded.
units.verify: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。~Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source.
units.failure: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。~Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources.
units.misconception: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降~A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
units.practice: 對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比~Train piston flow and blockage ratio
units.title: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比~Train piston flow and blockage ratio
units.mechanism: 列車進入受限斷面時排擠空氣，列車截面乘速度提供幾何排量的量級。實際空氣可經車旁間隙、通風井和相鄰隧道分流，因此幾何排量不是某一通風井的實測流量。 列車排開體積的模型首先遵守連續方程，但洩漏、車站開口與可壓縮效應會改變實際流場。應明確使用剩餘通流面積，不能用整個隧道面積忽略車體阻塞。 用列車排開的體積檢查隧道壓力與風速的簡化關係。~A train displaces air in a confined section, and frontal area times speed gives the geometric displacement scale. Air divides through the annular gap, shafts and adjoining tunnels. Geometric displacement therefore does not equal measured flow through a particular ventilation shaft. A displaced-volume model first follows continuity, but leakage, station openings and compressibility alter the actual field. Use the remaining flow area explicitly rather than the whole tunnel area while ignoring train blockage. Use displaced train volume to inspect a simplified relationship between tunnel flow and pressure.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：train_area=9.18 m^2; speed=20 m/s；計算：displacement_flow=train_area*speed=183.6 m^3/s。敏感度：train_area 單獨增加百分之十至 10.098 m^2，其餘固定，結果為 201.96 m^3/s。模型邊界：不可壓縮幾何排量；未求壓差、流路分配與空氣壓縮。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: train_area=9.18 m^2; speed=20 m/s; calculation: displacement_flow=train_area*speed=183.6 m^3/s. Sensitivity: train_area, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 10.098 m^2, with all other inputs fixed, gives 201.96 m^3/s. Model boundary: Incompressible geometric displacement; pressure difference, path splitting and compressibility are not solved.
units.verify: 以列車位置同步觸發各風井和月台風速量測，檢查流量方向與時間差，避免把瞬時尖峰當成持續換氣能力。 在列車通過前後同步量測風速、壓力及位置，以多點截面平均避免局部噴流誤差。~Trigger shaft and platform air-velocity measurements from train position, inspect direction and delay, and avoid treating a brief peak as continuous ventilation capacity. Synchronise airflow, pressure and train position around passage, using a multipoint section average to avoid bias from local jets.
units.failure: 風井受阻時氣流可能轉移到月台，造成局部強風；單一風速計又可能量到回流區而低估主流。 局部風速尖峰不能當作整段平均流量，須核對截面分布。~A blocked shaft can redirect flow toward the platform and create local gusts; one anemometer inside a recirculation region may underestimate the main flow. A local velocity peak cannot represent whole-section flow; inspect the cross-sectional distribution.
units.misconception: 列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量~Train frontal area times speed is the identical flow received by every ventilation shaft.
units.practice: 將總排量分配到兩條假想阻力路徑，畫出質量守恆圖，再說明需要哪些壓差資料才能求分流比例。 再以本單元 train_area 的對照值重算 displacement_flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Divide the displacement among two hypothetical resistance paths, draw the mass balance, and identify the pressure measurements required to determine the split. Also recalculate displacement_flow for the alternative train_area value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.title: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.mechanism: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 在最遠受電位置估算壓降，列明供電和回流路徑。~Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Estimate voltage drop at the farthest receiving position and state supply and return paths.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1530 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=91.8 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1683 A，其餘固定，結果為 100.98 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1530 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=91.8 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1683 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 100.98 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。 同步量測供電端與受電端電壓及回路電流，核對接線極性和設備接頭的額外壓降。~Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes. Measure supply voltage, receiving voltage and loop current synchronously, checking polarity and extra voltage drops across equipment connections.
units.failure: 高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 需核對回流路徑，否則可能把接頭故障藏在錯估電阻中。~A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. Verify the return path so a faulty connection is not hidden inside an incorrect resistance estimate.
units.misconception: 量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常~Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
units.practice: 加入第二列同時加速的列車，畫出共享與非共享饋線段，分段重算壓降並說明何時需改用完整潮流分析。 再以本單元 current 的對照值重算 drop，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a second accelerating train, distinguish shared and separate feeder sections, recalculate each drop, and explain when a complete load-flow analysis becomes necessary. Also recalculate drop for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 振動隔離與頻率比~Vibration isolation and frequency ratio
units.title: 振動隔離與頻率比~Vibration isolation and frequency ratio
units.mechanism: 浮動道床可用彈簧質量阻尼器理解，其隔振效果取決於激振頻率與固有頻率的比值。接近共振時柔軟支承反而會放大響應，超過隔振區後才可能衰減；靜態撓度與動態效果需要同時檢查。 此式描述單自由度線性隔振系統的力傳遞率，頻率比是激振頻率除以固有頻率。增加阻尼有助於抑制共振，但在高頻隔振區不一定降低傳遞；必須先辨認工況所在區域。 對地下設備隔振基座比較激振頻率與固有頻率的比例。~A floating track slab can be understood as a spring-mass-damper system whose isolation depends on excitation-to-natural-frequency ratio. Soft support can amplify response near resonance before attenuating higher frequencies. Static deflection and dynamic performance therefore need to be checked together. This expression describes force transmissibility of a linear single-degree-of-freedom isolator. Frequency ratio is excitation frequency divided by natural frequency. Added damping suppresses resonance but need not reduce transmission in the high-frequency isolation region, so identify the operating region first. Compare excitation and natural frequency for an underground-equipment isolation mount.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：ratio=3.06 1; zeta=0.12 1；計算：transmissibility=((1+(2*zeta*ratio)**2)/((1-ratio**2)**2+(2*zeta*ratio)**2))**0.5=0.1477769 1。敏感度：ratio 單獨增加百分之十至 3.366 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.1240687 1。模型邊界：線性單自由度力傳遞率；不含土層波傳、側向耦合及建築響應。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: ratio=3.06 1; zeta=0.12 1; calculation: transmissibility=((1+(2*zeta*ratio)**2)/((1-ratio**2)**2+(2*zeta*ratio)**2))**0.5=0.1477769 1. Sensitivity: ratio, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 3.366 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.1240687 1. Model boundary: Linear single-degree-of-freedom force transmissibility; soil propagation, lateral coupling and building response are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測軌道、道床與鄰近結構振動，使用頻譜比值而非只比較總加速度，並記錄列車速度與載重。 同步量測基座與支承反力頻譜，核對激振頻率、固有頻率和阻尼，檢查兩測點相位。~Measure rail, slab and neighbouring-structure vibration synchronously, compare spectra rather than only overall acceleration, and retain train speed and load. Measure base and transmitted-force spectra synchronously, verifying excitation frequency, natural frequency and damping while checking phase between measurement points.
units.failure: 隔振墊硬化會提高固有頻率，局部短路接觸則繞過彈性路徑；兩者都可能讓預期隔振頻段失效。 阻尼器劣化與剛度改變會有不同頻譜，須分開辨識。~Pad hardening raises natural frequency, while a rigid local contact bypasses the elastic path; either can remove the intended isolation band. Damper deterioration and stiffness change produce different spectral effects and must be identified separately.
units.misconception: 支承越柔軟所有頻率的振動就一定越小~Softer supports necessarily reduce vibration at every frequency.
units.practice: 計算接近共振與高頻兩種頻率比，畫出傳遞率趨勢，提出能辨別材料硬化與剛性短路的量測位置。 再以本單元 ratio 的對照值重算 transmissibility，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate near-resonant and high-frequency ratios, plot the transmission trend, and propose sensor locations distinguishing material hardening from a rigid bypass. Also recalculate transmissibility for the alternative ratio value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 備援電池與可維持時間~Backup battery endurance
units.title: 備援電池與可維持時間~Backup battery endurance
units.mechanism: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。低溫、老化及啟動電流會縮短可用時間；額定安時也不能直接當成瓦時。 可用電量應扣除允許放電深度與轉換損失，負載也可能隨時間變化。銘牌容量的測試溫度和放電倍率會影響實際結果，續航計算不能取代受控放電驗證。 把資訊顯示、通訊和照明分開列出備援能源負載。~Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency. Dividing by load gives ideal endurance. Cold temperature, ageing and start-up current can shorten it; an ampere-hour rating must not be mistaken directly for watt-hours. Usable energy must account for permitted discharge depth and conversion losses, while load may vary over time. Test temperature and discharge rate influence rated capacity, so an endurance calculation cannot replace controlled discharge verification. List backup-energy loads separately for information displays, communication and lighting.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.4 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.672 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.44 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 4.0392 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.4 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.672 h. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.44 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4.0392 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded.
units.verify: 定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。 以受控負載記錄電池電壓、電流與溫度，積分可用電量，核對低壓切斷時刻。~Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Record battery voltage, current and temperature under controlled load, integrate usable energy, and verify the low-voltage cut-off time.
units.failure: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。~An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Normal open-circuit voltage does not prove sufficient capacity; inspect the loaded discharge curve.
units.misconception: 備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間~Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.
units.practice: 將負載增加一成並把可用容量降為老化假設值，重新計算時間，提出量測端電壓以外必須保留的證據。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 endurance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase load and reduce usable capacity for an ageing case, recalculate endurance, and identify evidence required beyond terminal-voltage readings. Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.title: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.mechanism: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 檢查兩個控制通道是否仍共享機房、時鐘或電源。~When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Check whether two control channels still share a room, clock or supply.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1。敏感度：q1 單獨增加百分之十至 0.02244 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.0006732 1。模型邊界：同一時間窗內獨立失效且切換完美；不含共同原因與切換失敗。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1. Sensitivity: q1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.02244 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.0006732 1. Model boundary: Independent failures in one time window with perfect switching; common causes and switch failure are excluded.
units.verify: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。~Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states.
units.failure: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。~Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies.
units.misconception: 只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低~Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
units.practice: 在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
